---
title: "References"
bibliography: packages.bib
output: word_document
---



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#This template helps you generate a reference list
# of the packages you use.  Update the list of 
# packages in the second code chunk. 
# Knit to Word and download the file.
# Then you can copy and paste the results into your 
# supplemental materials.

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE,  comment = NA)
library(knitcitations)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
# create a bibfile with packages you have used. "base" refers 
# to base R.
write_bib(c('base', 'knitr','rmarkdown','posterdown','pagedown', 'easystats', 'icorp26', 'ggplot2', 'sjPlot'), 'packages.bib')

knitcitations::read.bibtex(file = 'packages.bib')  
```
